title: Missing authentication in FortiManager fgfmd
rawTitle: TT-CSIRT – 436.24.10.24. Missing Authentication in FortiManager fgfmd
leadParagraph: Fortinet has released a patch to address a critical vulnerability in their FortiManager product. This vulnerability allows threat actors to use a compromised FortiManager device to execute arbitrary code or commands via specially crafted requests against other FortiManager devices, through a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability [CWE-306] in FortiManager fgfmd daemon.   Reports have shown this vulnerability to be exploited in the wild.
